Message:
B-Before falling into
the sprawling abyss,
I somehow managed to guide
everyone to different worlds.

But Elaine managed to escape
and head towards “Paradise”...

And now, I find myself in
a strange, unfamiliar world too...

Hehehe. I’ve got to find
the others as soon as I can...

...W-Wait a minute.
I don’t see
a single fairy anywhere...
Why...?

...Hehe. Ehehe...
Having the fairies around to help
was all I had going for me,

and now that even they’re gone...
Ehe. Ehehe...

I really do...have no purpose now...
Hgh!

What do I do now...?
Help me...
Guinevere, wherever you are,
please...help meee...!
